resources.string: Messages arrive at once; a permanent notification shows, and it costs a little battery.
Only while the app is open
Messages wait until you open Sparrow: up to 7 days, first invites 24 hours.
Android checks every 15 minutes at most, less in deep sleep: messages come late, little battery.
Sparrow uses no Google push, so no company learns when you get messages, and nobody needs a key from us to run a server. Android only lets an app keep its own connection with a visible notification.
In the battery list Android opens, choose All apps, then Sparrow, and set it to Not optimized.
Without the battery exception, Android may drop the connection in deep sleep.
On iPhone, Sparrow cannot keep the connection open in the background because of iOS restrictions. Messages arrive when you open the app.
